title: Agent Hive Configuration
description: Configuration schema for ~/.config/opencode/agent_hive.json, the only Agent Hive runtime configuration source. Project-local .hive/agent-hive.json and .opencode/agent_hive.json files are ignored.

$schema.description: Schema reference for this config file

sandbox.description: Global sandbox isolation mode. 'none' runs commands directly; 'docker' wraps bash commands in Docker containers.

dockerImage.description: Global Docker image override. Auto-detected from active project files if omitted (e.g., node:22-slim for Node.js projects).

persistentContainers.description: Reuse Docker containers per worktree (docker exec) instead of creating new ones per command (docker run --rm). Default: true when sandbox is 'docker'.

omoSlimEnabled.description: Enable compatibility with the oh-my-opencode slim agent profile.

repositoryRoot.description: Deprecated migration-only absolute project root for legacy globally stored repository topology. Use <project>/.hive/repositories.json.

repositories.description: Deprecated migration-only globally stored repository topology scoped by repositoryRoot. New writes use <project>/.hive/repositories.json.

enableToolsFor.description: Globally enable hive tools for specific features.

disableSkills.description: Globally disable specific Hive bundled skills (e.g., ['brainstorming', 'writing-plans']). Disabled skills are excluded from Hive materialization and Hive bundled autoload. Does not block user or native skills with the same name.

disableMcps.description: Globally disable specific MCP servers (e.g., ['websearch', 'ast_grep']). Available: websearch, context7, grep_app, ast_grep

agentMode.description: Agent specialization mode. 'unified' (default) uses a single hybrid agent for all roles; 'dedicated' uses specialized agents for each role.

hook_cadence.description: Global hook execution cadence configuration. Key = hook name, Value = number of turns between invocations (1 = every turn, 3 = every 3rd turn). All hooks default to 1.

additionalProperties.description: Number of turns between hook invocations

customAgents.description: Global custom Hive subagent definitions derived from scout-researcher, forager-worker, plan-reviewer, code-reviewer, simplicity-reviewer, or approach-advisor. Project-local values are ignored by runtime config resolution. IDs cannot reuse built-in or plugin-reserved names. dash-reviewer remains available for existing custom configuration because the command uses a private runtime identity.

defaultGroup.description: Default council group name to use when a command does not specify one. The referenced group is resolved later by command rendering.

maxMembers.description: Maximum number of council members selected for a command.

excludedAgents.description: Agent names excluded from council selection. Names are structurally accepted here and resolved later by command rendering.

groups.description: Named council groups. Each declared group replaces the default group declaration of the same name during global config merge.

councilGroupConfig.description: Council group declaration. Member names are structurally accepted here and resolved later by command rendering.

members.description: Agent names available in this council group.

maxMembers.description: Maximum number of members selected from this group.

id.description: Safe repository ID used as a path segment and branch component (for example, api, web-ui, data.v2).

path.description: Project-relative path to a git repository.

skills.description: Legacy field kept for config compatibility. Native skill visibility is controlled by OpenCode skills.paths registration and disableSkills, not by per-agent skills allowlists.

autoLoadSkills.description: Native discovered or Hive bundled skill names to advertise in this agent prompt as high-priority skill tool load guidance. Native/user skills are resolved by frontmatter name and take precedence over Hive bundles.

variant.description: Variant key for model reasoning/effort level (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'max'). Must match a key in opencode.json provider.<provider>.models.<model>.variants

baseAgent.description: Built-in Hive agent to inherit prompt/tools/permissions from

description.description: Human-facing description injected into delegation guidance

variant.description: Variant override for model reasoning/effort level

autoLoadSkills.description: Additional native discovered or Hive bundled skill names to advertise in this custom agent prompt as high-priority skill tool load guidance. Merged with inherited base autoLoadSkills; disableSkills only suppresses Hive bundled guidance/materialization, not native/user skills with the same name.
